channel.title: The Forge — TRE Forged
channel.description: Practical, jargon-free personal finance guides from TRE Forged: budgeting, saving, debt payoff, and getting the most out of Forgenta.

item.title: How to Safely Jump-Start a Car (Correct Cable Order, Step by Step)
item.description: Learn the correct jumper cable order, key safety warnings, what to do if your car still won't start, and how to tell a dead battery from a bad alternator.

item.title: How to Budget When Your Income Is Irregular: A Guide for Freelancers and Gig Workers
item.description: Learn how to budget on an irregular income by planning off your lowest month, building a buffer account, and smoothing out feast-or-famine cash flow.

item.title: How to Pay Off Credit Card Debt Faster: The Math, the Strategy, and How to Avoid Relapse
item.description: Learn the interest math behind credit card debt, a proven extra-payment strategy, when balance transfers actually help, and how to avoid falling back into debt in 2026.

item.title: Cash Flow Forecasting for Regular People: How to Stop Overdrafts Before They Start
item.description: Learn how to forecast your bank balance forward a few weeks so you can spot overdrafts, avoid fees, and stop financial stress before it starts.

item.title: How to Rotate Your Tires at Home: A Beginner's Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Learn why tire rotation matters, which pattern fits your drivetrain, and how to jack up your car safely to rotate tires at home in 2026.

item.title: Good Debt vs. Bad Debt: Does the Distinction Hold Up?
item.description: A grounded look at the good debt vs. bad debt idea, why it oversimplifies real life, and a better framework for deciding when borrowing helps or hurts.

item.title: How to Build Credit From Scratch: A Beginner's Guide for 2026
item.description: Learn how to build credit from scratch in 2026 with secured cards, credit builder loans, smart utilization habits, and patience that pays off.

item.title: The 5 Things That Actually Affect Your Credit Score (and What to Fix First)
item.description: Confused about your credit score? Here's a plain-English breakdown of the 5 FICO factors and exactly what to prioritize to see real improvement in 2026.

item.title: How to Change Your Own Oil (Step by Step)
item.description: A beginner-friendly, step-by-step guide to changing your car's oil at home, including tools, oil selection, draining, refilling, and disposal tips.

item.title: How to Prioritize Multiple Savings Goals at Once (Emergency Fund, Debt, Retirement, and More)
item.description: Juggling an emergency fund, debt payoff, retirement, and a big purchase? Here's the order that actually works and why, step by step.

item.title: How to Change Your Engine Air Filter in 10 Minutes (Beginner-Friendly Guide)
item.description: Learn how to change your engine air filter yourself in about 10 minutes, save money on maintenance, and know exactly when it's time for a fresh one.

item.title: How Credit Card Interest Actually Works: APR, Grace Periods, and Minimum Payments Explained
item.description: A plain-English breakdown of credit card APR, daily interest, grace periods, and minimum payments, with real math so you can see where your money goes.

item.title: The Monthly Money Review: A 30-Minute Habit That Changes Everything
item.description: Learn how to run a simple 30-minute monthly money review with this step-by-step checklist for tracking spending, savings, and debt in 2026.

item.title: The 15-Minute Subscription Audit That Saves You Hundreds
item.description: Learn how to find and cancel forgotten subscriptions in just 15 minutes with this step-by-step audit that can save you hundreds of dollars a year.

item.title: How to Check All Your Car's Fluids: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Learn where to find and how to check your car's oil, coolant, brake, power steering, transmission, and washer fluid in about 20 minutes.

item.title: How to Automate Your Finances So Saving Happens on Its Own
item.description: Learn how to automate bills, savings, and debt payments in 2026 so your money moves on schedule without relying on willpower or memory.

item.title: 20 Realistic Ways to Cut Your Monthly Expenses in 2026
item.description: 20 practical, no-extreme-frugality ways to lower your monthly bills, ranked from easy quick wins to bigger changes with the biggest payoff.

item.title: Sinking Funds Explained: The Budgeting Trick That Ends Money Surprises
item.description: Learn what sinking funds are, which budget categories need one, and how to set them up so irregular expenses never blow up your budget again.

item.title: How to Check Your Tire Pressure and Tread (And Why It Saves You Real Money)
item.description: Learn to check tire PSI and tread depth in minutes with a simple gauge and the penny test, and see how proper pressure saves fuel and extends tire life.

item.title: High-Yield Savings Accounts: What They Are and Why They Matter
item.description: Learn how high-yield savings accounts work, what to compare before opening one, and how they fit into a solid emergency fund plan in 2026.
